COMPANY: Tvrtle ROLE: Founding Full Stack Engineer LOCATION: Remote COMMITMENT: Part-time / flexible COMPENSATION: Equity TECH: Laravel, Vue, Tailwind, AWS

Tvrtle is building a portfolio of software products across SaaS, developer tools, and niche consumer apps.

We're looking for a founding engineer who enjoys building products from scratch and wants meaningful ownership in what we create.

You'll work directly with the technical founder and help design, build, and launch products used by real users.

More details: https://tvrtle.com/FOUNDING_ENGINEER.md
